question: Identify the antonym of "Insipid"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Appetizing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Insipid"** means something that is lacking flavor, vigor, or interest. (नीरस, बेस्वाद)
 
 
• **Example:** The soup was insipid and needed more seasoning.
